caption:
Singapore talks with US to keep access to advanced AI chips

Deputy PM Gan Kim Yong says the talks follow tighter US export restrictions on chips to the Southeast Asian city-state. Gan spoke at a local event on Friday. Singapore is reviewing its processes as it seeks to retain access to advanced semiconductors.

Reported by The Information; Bloomberg.
